o.text: From qış + -laq. Cognate with Turkish kışlak, Turkmen gyşlag, Uzbek qishloq, Kazakh қыстау (qıstaw), Kyrgyz кыштак (kıştak), etc.
From Middle Mongol ᠬᠡᠰᠢᠭᠲᠡᠨ (kesigten, “blessing”). Compare Turkish keşik (“turn”), Mongolian хишигтэн (xišigten).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اشده (uşda, işde), ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *oš. Cognate with Turkish işte.
